card.name: Military history before unit names
card.fires_on: Small linking words or spaces (the, as, in, by, an) in war and military history prose, just before a unit, corps, or army term is named.

modes.label: Linking word before a unit
modes.description: A small word such as the, as, or in right before a military unit or service branch in a World War account.
modes.example: Hitler volunteered for service in the German army and was accepted into<< the>> infantry.

modes.label: Space before a numbered unit
modes.description: A space token before a numbered regiment or a game's player count in military or sport text.
modes.example: Company B,<< >>34th Virginia Infantry arrived in Petersburg

card.writes: It seems to push toward military and group-unit words such as pack, contingent, and assault terms, and away from unrelated words.
card.plain: It lights up on small words in war-history writing right before a regiment, corps, or force is named.
